entities.name: Milton W. Glenn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milton Willits Glenn was an American lawyer, World War II veteran, and Republican Party politician who represented New Jersey's 2nd congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1957 to 1965.
